snippet.title: Wreckreation 2
snippet.description:
Wreckreation 2 is an open-world arcade racing game where every slam, every shortcut, and every takedown can change the outcome. We've spent a lot of time thinking about what makes arcade racing special. That feeling of being completely engaged with the road ahead of you: reading traffic, reacting to rivals, taking risks, making split-second decisions. 

If this is the kind of game you've been missing please show your support by wishlisting the game on Steam. 

Wishlist now on Steam https://store.steampowered.com/app/4734020/Wreckreation_2/?utm_source=youtube&utm_campaign=announce

Follow development on Patreon https://patreon.com/u10680381

Join our new Discord https://whentidesturn.com/discord (note this is a different Discord to the Wreckreation 1 one)
